title: Evaluating the accuracy of generative artificial intelligence models in dental age estimation based on the Demirjian's method

live_model.evidence: "The ChatGPT model GPT-4-turbo (OpenAI)...all of which were offered free, were used in this study." Full prompt quoted (Demirjian maturity-score question); tests run Mar-Apr 2025.

prompt.location: Sec "Prompt design and LLM" (question quoted in full: "Provide the estimated dental age based on the Demirjian's method...")
prompt.note: 27 evaluations per scenario (3 computers x 3 evaluations/day x 3 days).

claim.metric: MAE / RMSE / R2 / Bias vs. chronological age
claim.location: Statistical analysis section (values not captured in this excerpt)

data.source: in-house dental radiographs; Demirjian staging performed by examiners, not released as a dataset

notes: "ChatGPT" + "offered free" indicates the consumer chat interface rather than a pinned API snapshot, so the exact backing model behind the free-tier "GPT-4-turbo" selector in March-April 2025 cannot be guaranteed to be gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09. The prompt itself is fully reproducible if resolved via API instead.
